input.description:
The image shows the back of a food package with a Nutrition Facts label and cooking directions. The Nutrition Facts label provides information for a serving size of 1/2 cup dry mix (64g) with about 2.5 servings per container. It lists the calories as 230 per serving and 320 per prepared portion. The label includes details on total fat, cholesterol, sodium, total carbohydrates, dietary fiber, total sugars, added sugars, and protein. It also provides information on vitamins and minerals such as Vitamin D, calcium, iron, potassium, thiamin, riboflavin, niacin, and folate.

To the right of the Nutrition Facts, there are stovetop and microwave directions for preparing the food. Below this, there is a section titled "Our Promise" and a QR code for scanning with a phone camera for more recipes and inspiration. The bottom of the package shows an image of a prepared dish with vegetables like tomatoes and zucchini.
all_user_responses: What are the directions on how to make this item?
